retrievalProfile.description: A retro layout featuring a bold red header bar, a yellow central field mimicking a telegram form, and a group portrait emerging from a paper-tear effect.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tiered composition consisting of a thick red top banner with white sans-serif text, a large yellow central area containing angled serif display type and typewriter-style body text, and a bottom section featuring a group of men in suits appearing to step through a jagged hole in the yellow surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red header provides a heavy visual anchor at the top.
Angled display text in the center creates dynamic movement against the static grid.
The jagged paper-tear effect integrates the photographic subject into the graphic background.
High-contrast yellow and red color blocks define the primary hierarchy.
coreInvariants: Solid red horizontal header bar spanning the full width.
Pale yellow background for the main body area.
Jagged white 'torn paper' silhouette framing the photographic subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Group portrait located in the bottom half, scaled to occupy approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick red header bar at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting at the red header, moving through the angled central text, and landing on the group portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant yellow negative space in the upper-middle section to accommodate text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale yellow background for the central field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red for the top header bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for primary and secondary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red header contrasted with a desaturated, warm yellow field.

letterConstructionRules: Header uses wide, low-contrast geometric sans-serif.
Main title uses high-contrast transitional serifs with sharp terminals.
Body text mimics monospaced typewriter output.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a modern sans-serif for branding and a classical serif for thematic content.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, wide sans-serif header style.
Matches the traditional serif look of the angled title.
Matches the telegram message body text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a layout with a solid red bar at the top and a pale yellow field below. In the bottom half, place a group of men in 1960s suits emerging from a jagged, white-edged hole that looks like torn paper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white sans-serif text centered in the red bar. Add black serif text in the yellow field, angled slightly upwards. Include small typewriter-style text blocks and thin-lined rectangular boxes to mimic a telegram form.

verificationChecks: Is the top bar solid red with white text?
Is the central title text angled?
Does the photo have a jagged 'torn paper' edge?
Is the background a consistent pale yellow?

adjustableVariables: Height of the red header bar
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red header is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the typewriter text is monospaced.
Verify the paper tear looks physical rather than a digital brush stroke.
Confirm the yellow is a warm, aged tone.
recipe.reuseFormula: Red Header + Yellow Field + Angled Serif + Torn Paper Photo Mask
